about.h1:
We treat packaging
as a commitment, not a box.
about.p1: Founded as a small print shop in Me Linh, {company} now runs 4 integrated production lines — from corrugating and flexo printing to die-cutting and finishing. We serve factories, retail chains and F&B brands that need packaging built to spec and delivered on time.
about.p2: Our philosophy is simple: a dented box or a torn bag handle is a broken promise to the end customer. That's why every batch is tested for compression strength, moisture and print adhesion before it leaves the plant.

values.title: Built to spec
values.text: Compression (ECT) and burst strength (BST) tested before every large production run.

values.title: On schedule
values.text: Transparent production timeline, with status updates at every stage.

values.title: Sustainable materials
values.text: FSC-certified recycled paper by default, phasing out single-use plastics.
